name: University of Southern Indiana
oos_note: Public university. Out-of-state tuition & fees $22,907 (in-state $10,066) per NCES College Navigator 2024-25. USI bursar page lists 2026-27 per-credit-hour rates: non-resident $727.23/cr vs resident $299.19/cr (~2.43x), confirming a substantially higher non-resident rate. NCES annual tuition & fees figure used to match the in-state 'tuition & fees' basis.
